topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Group code of conduct and annual policy acknowledgments; sanctions procedure (POL-01 4.7)
Board risk committee oversees cyber risk for all divisions quarterly
Group CISO, the Grocery Wholesale security and compliance lead, and the portal owner have defined reporting lines (POL-01 4.2)
Background checks; annual awareness and role-based training for portal developers and support staff (POL-05 4.3, 4.4)
evidence: Screening records; learning system report (P07 AT-2 satisfied)

control_description: Security objectives in portal team goals; sanctions applied for violations
Portal component inventory and data flows maintained by the portal team
control_owner: Grocery Wholesale security and compliance lead
gap: The inventory does not show which controls the portal inherits from group providers (scenario gap 9; P07 CA-02b.01)
remediation: Inheritance matrix for SYS-D5 in the common control catalog (POAM-018)

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Portal staff receive group policies, the division supplement, and runbooks; changes announced through the division security channel
control_owner: Grocery Wholesale security and compliance lead

control_description: Customer terms and the portal help center describe security and support
evidence: Portal terms of use; supply agreement (2024 form)
gap: No system description, no written security and availability commitments, and no description of complementary user entity controls; the portal terms describe a stronger security model than practice (P03 WD-G13)
remediation: Write the system description and service commitments; align the portal terms with practice; customer communication on user responsibilities

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Portal objectives for security, availability, and confidentiality set in the division plan
Risks identified and analyzed in the Grocery Wholesale register (P01) using SP 800-30
control_owner: Grocery Wholesale security and compliance lead

control_description: Fraud risks considered: account takeover to divert orders or payments, business email compromise, price list theft
control_owner: Grocery Wholesale security and compliance lead

control_description: Portal releases go through change review with security sign-off
gap: Changes made by group providers (tag containers, front door rules, customer identity settings) are not assessed for their effect on the portal
remediation: Add the portal as an affected system in group change review for SYS-G3 and SYS-G4 changes

control_description: Annual group internal audit sampling; quarterly access certification
gap: Inherited controls have never been assessed for the portal (P07 CA-02d.[01])
remediation: Include SYS-D5 inherited controls in the 2027 assessment plan (POAM-018)

control_description: Deficiencies tracked in the group POA&M and reported to the division president and the board risk committee

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from the risk register and the common control catalog
control_owner: Grocery Wholesale security and compliance lead

control_description: General IT controls inherited from group identity, cloud, and SOC providers
evidence: P07 common control results (135 of 158 statements satisfied)

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Group policies and the Grocery Wholesale supplement v2026 (aligned 2026-06-30)
control_owner: Grocery Wholesale security and compliance lead

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: Workforce access through group single sign-on with MFA; customer sign-in through the group customer identity service; data encrypted at rest
gap: Customer MFA is optional; customer-specific prices sit in shared tables and rely on application checks that are not tested automatically (P01 WD-012)
remediation: Require customer MFA (POAM-023); automated cross-customer access tests in every release

control_description: Grocers create and remove their own store users through an administrator account
gap: About 30% of grocer accounts are shared among store staff, so users cannot be traced or removed individually (P03 WD-G19)
remediation: Named user accounts for every grocer store user; quarterly customer administrator attestation (POAM-023)

control_description: Workforce portal roles approved in identity governance; quarterly certification; termination within 4 hours
evidence: P07 AC-2, PS-4 results; certification records

control_description: Physical security inherited from cloud provider A and provider B
Media sanitization and disposal under POL-04 4.7; cloud storage deletion by provider

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Front door web application firewall, bot management, and breached-password checks; landing zone network controls

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS for all portal traffic; card data entered only in the processor hosted payment fields; ACH data encrypted

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: Endpoint protection on portal hosts; scripts on portal pages managed through the shared tag management service
gap: The invoice payment page loads the shared "all pages" tag container, so unreviewed scripts can run beside the hosted payment fields (P03 WD-G09; P07 SC-18b.[03])
remediation: Payments-only container with page owner approval; script inventory with integrity values (POAM-001)

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Quarterly vulnerability scans and annual penetration test of the portal
control_owner: Grocery Wholesale security and compliance lead
gap: No change and tamper detection on the invoice payment page (P03 WD-G10)
remediation: Payment page monitoring with alerts to the SOC (POAM-002)

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: Portal and identity logs in the group SIEM; 24x7 SOC
gap: Payment page alerts do not reach the SOC; no use case for unusual changes to grocer bank or delivery details
remediation: Route alerts to the SOC (POAM-002); add a use case for account and payment detail changes

control_description: Security events triaged by the SOC under the group severity scale
Group incident response plan and the P08 runbook
gap: The 72-hour customer notice in the supply agreement and the wholesale acquirer notice are new in the P08 matrix and have not been exercised (P03 WD-G12, WD-G14)

control_description: Recovery through the group playbooks; portal rebuilt from code in provider B
Portal code changes reviewed, tested, and approved in the release pipeline
gap: Tags published to the payment page through the shared container bypass portal change approval (P07 CM-03b.[02])
remediation: Bring payment page tags under portal change control (POAM-001)

control_description: Business disruption risks covered by the BIA and contingency plans; cyber insurance

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Vendors reviewed under POL-01 4.8: cloud provider A, the payment processor (AOC), the customer identity service
control_owner: Grocery Wholesale security and compliance lead
gap: The tag management vendor and its script vendors are not reviewed (P03 WD-G11)
remediation: Add them to the TPSP list and review them (POAM-003)

control_description: Autoscaling and capacity monitoring; peak ordering windows planned
Managed database replicas; immutable backups and a warm standby in provider B
evidence: Backup reports; P07 CP-9 restore of the portal database (satisfied)

control_description: Portal failover to provider B tested in 2026-05
gap: The digital front door (customer sign-in, WAF, tag management) the portal depends on has never been recovery-tested as a whole (P05)

topic_label: Identification and maintenance of confidential information
control_description: Customer price files, promotions, and order history classified Confidential (POL-04 4.1)
gap: Account managers can download any customer's price files, not only their assigned accounts (P01 WD-016)
remediation: Limit downloads to assigned accounts; alert on bulk downloads

control_description: Customer data deleted on request when a grocer leaves
gap: No defined retention period or deletion schedule for departed customers' data; deletion is manual
remediation: Retention schedule for customer data; automated deletion with certificates
